assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL Minecraft Mekanism-style Hephaestus Forge automation controller texture atlas for a new mod. The attached atlas is ONLY a style reference for neutral gray casing and coarse pixels, not an edit target. Generate a NEW square flat opaque atlas in an exact equal 2x2 grid, no margins, no text: top-left idle front, top-right top, bottom-left side/back/bottom, bottom-right active front. Each quadrant must have the simplicity of precisely 16x16 large solid-color pixel cells. At least 90% charcoal and neutral gray. Heavy gray casing, thick simple corners, recessed black mechanical work area. Front feature: a very small gray anvil silhouette under a short vertical hammer mechanism, with four tiny status pixels along the bottom in subdued yellow, teal, red, green to indicate native forge resources. Top has a single square mechanical socket and two vents. Side is a simple gray industrial grille. Idle and active front geometry MUST be identical, only the four status pixels become brighter. No golden border, fantasy decoration, glyphs, foliage, wood, gradient, bloom, noise, perspective, scene, white gaps, transparency or watermark. Full block faces fill each quadrant edge to edge. Crisp coarse pixel art readable at actual 16x16.
